subject: renderPrint() not behaving like the print to screen for summary()

messages.author: 4114912dbf9e2d36
messages.subject: renderPrint() not behaving like the print to screen for summary()
parts:
When at the command line, summary(myDataFrame) will give a neatly formatted summary, but when doing:
    output$summary <- renderPrint({
        summary(dataTable)
    })

it is not neat at all, and barely readable. What is the correct way to pass the summary function to renderPrint() so that it prints neatly?
